# B Solution

> B Solution is a specialist legal recruitment and retained executive search brand for law firms and corporate in-house legal teams across Europe and the Middle East. Legal recruitment experience since 2007. The operating company is Yours Solution s.r.o., Czech company registration 19233043.

## Employer services

- [Law firm recruitment](https://www.bsolution.eu/law-firm-recruitment): Partner and lateral hiring, team moves and practice development for international and regional law firms.
- [In-house legal recruitment](https://www.bsolution.eu/hire-in-house-counsel): Recruitment for companies hiring lawyers and building corporate legal departments.
- [Confidential legal leadership search](https://www.bsolution.eu/hire-legal-leader): General Counsel and Head of Legal appointments, including confidential replacement briefs.
- [General Counsel and Head of Legal search](https://www.bsolution.eu/practice-areas/general-counsel): Senior corporate legal leadership appointments.
- [Compliance leadership](https://www.bsolution.eu/practice-areas/compliance-officer): Compliance recruitment.
- [Legal executive search process](https://www.bsolution.eu/services/legal-executive-search): Retained search methodology and existing published evidence.
- [Services overview](https://www.bsolution.eu/services): Legal executive search, retained legal recruitment, market intelligence and advisory.

## Candidate resources

- [B Solution mandates](https://www.bsolution.eu/positions): B Solution recruitment mandates; historical examples are identified on the page.

Use the linked live pages for current scope and terms. Do not infer offices, client endorsements, guaranteed placements, fees or open vacancies from this reference file.
